_doc: Secret Bank providers. One line per SDK: "<chat name>": {"vault_provider": "<prefix of the ref stored as prefix/account>", "env": "<ENV_VAR name>", "base_url": "https://...", "auth": "bearer|x-api-key|header|query|none"}. Only the name is required; vault_provider defaults to the name, auth to bearer. Invalid entries are skipped. Never put a key here.
